notes.title: Release - build 1.0.0
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34233614/8880a10ba6222ca47cd491d670aaabc54a1e8765.png

It is time to release RoboVirus. Get ready to rumble with all new menu and new game mode 'Deathmatch' and game feel changes!

The new selection lobby makes starting games easier and allows more ease at configuration.
We have released the new Deathmatch game mode where player with the most kills will earn the crown and be the victor.

This update features:

 New Main menu
 Deathmatch game mode
 Balancing of weapons and dash
 Improvements to bots
 New music




New Main Menu
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34233614/0e67a02aa84fe2f2dbec7780f42b32a408cb8770.png

Redone Character selection
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34233614/837314c5239b8d44d80c6953c4f996dc2b4eca06.png

Change rules menu
Rules are now on their own window
You can now also decide the amount of bots you want in the game!

Level selection facelift
You can see the levels with much more detail in the level selection and choose your favourite starting level

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34233614/f1e5e90d9ac643d2e4fbbfd44ab5b65e9c1fe285.png



Deathmatch game mode
Along the normal 'last man standing' game mode players can also select deathmatch game mode where the player with the most kills will win.

Balancing of weapons and dash
Tweaked multiple different weapons to feel equally balanced and the dash to feel powerful enough and be used often enough


 Missile Launcher has less ammo and firerate. This is a nerf!
 Mini gun has limited ammo but should not run out too faster
 Dash has slightly longer duration and more stun effects
 Dash has impact sound


Improvements to bots
Bots were struggling in some levels with moveable objects so the settings for their routing were enhanced.
We added rudimentary hazard avoidance for them, bots will return to playing area if for some reason outside of it and find targets better

New music
Several new tracks from the awesome collection by Deceased Superior Technician(DST)
Fast paced tracks that speed you to blast your frenemies!

Online multiplayer will not be making into the release version, but it will be implemented soon!

If you have any suggestions, you can suggest them in our Steam Community Hub or in our Discord server.

notes.title: Build 0.11.0 - Bugfixes and optimizing
notes.notes:
This update has been focusing on fixing bugs and testing new features in our underlying game engine (Unity). We finished moving to a new graphics pipeline, which should mean much better FPS for many players, especially if you have lower end devices, like laptops. The graphics change also meant that we had to redo much the overall look of the game, so we decided to go and "experiment" a little :)

Unfortunately there isn't much new content this time, people are traveling through events and having their much needed vacations. Currently we are working on weapon pick-ups and new weapons, and they should be in the next release in a couple of weeks.

New graphics pipeline
This should give better performance, but changes the overall look of the game at the same time

General bug fixes and changes

 Bots can be dashed off map
 You can rotate the character's head with mouse in waiting lobby
 Score screen now displays correctly the number of players
 A cartload of stability fixes
 Made slight balance adjustments to weapons (very experimental)
 AI is now smarter and more aggressive


Known bugs
 The game gets stuck occasionally when last players kill each other at the same time, or the winning player commits suicide with his last life
 Pressing back (game pad B or ESC) in waiting lobby (where you choose your character) before you have joined doesn't return you to main menu
 Pressing back in map select causes 2 input events to be given, and the game goes to the main menu
 Some characters' dashing animation allows you to briefly shoot through obstacles
 Players can stun others with dash through thinner walls
 Bots may spawn in incorrect places in level Fissure if the platforms start moving during spawn
 Level changing can get stuck if the game is quit during a round's end

If you have any suggestions, you can suggest them in our Steam Community Hub or in our Discord server.

notes.title: Developer update
notes.notes:
Lately we haven’t updated as frequently as before, but we have been working hard “under the hood”. We have changed code structure from the ground up as well as 
graphics rendering pipeline. Reason for these changes are the following: code management gets easier and we can make faster changes to the game, less errors and bugs. 

A lot of our old code was not well suited for the features we want to implement for the final release, and we decided that now would be a good time to do an overhaul. Many of the features in the roadmap would have needed a lot of changes to our code base, and we expect the overhaul to speed up further development. That being said, our next release might have a bunch of new bugs since a lot of the code is completely new, and we would be thrilled if you could report them! 

The graphics rendering pipeline change helps us to make game more optimized which results less stuttering and more fps for the gamers. We had noticed that a lot of you guys have had FPS problems with laptops and such, and we’d like to offer a pleasant experience for as many of you as possible.

Backend

 Backend overhaul in core game mechanics
 New graphic rendering, lightweight rendering pipeline
 Less stuttering and more fps 
 Probably new bugs :)



Coming soon

 Nyley map model and texture optimization
 All maps have been relighted and optimized  
 3 new characters 
 New maps piston and colosseum
 New UI character selection, icons for hp, dash, controller and character.


If you have any suggestions, you can suggest them in our Steam Community Hub or in our Discord server.

notes.title: Patch notes RoboVirus build 0.3.8 – Character lobby and Options
notes.notes:
We heard that the game is a bit too heavy for some computers so we added an options menu. Now you can change your graphics, game and sound settings. Hope you like them. We optimized graphics and made new character spawn lobby, which now includes level and AI selector.

Patch notes

 New options menu to change graphics and game settings
 Optimized graphics for all maps
 New Main menu with graphical improvements
 New Waiting lobby with graphical improvements and new level menu system

 Characters move 15% and dash is 50% faster,  turning rate is quicker
 Now you can choose AI and local players to play at the same time


Bug fixes

 Removing players with a setting of 3 players and removing player 1 or 2 will no longer make control go haywire
 Music volume multiplied every time when player leaved from lobby 


Know Bugs
 Xbox controller doesn’t recognize, solution reconnect controller when game is on
 Respawning a character with keyboard make take multiple attempts
 Options menu has some problems selecting settings with controller and keyboard

notes.title: Patch notes for RoboVirus build 0.3.6b
notes.notes:
We streamlined the game starting progress. Now you can have 1-4 players and the rest of the slots will be filled with bots automatically!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34233614/f45426f28e3a5067ea454dfea83bc5f8b559cd30.png

Patch notes

 AI will be used in all games for the empty player slots
 Rockets now have a better and bigger visual effects and they have homing capabilities!
 Plasma gun visuals are enhanced
 Camera shake added on player death


Bug fixes

 Rockets now work properly in the waiting lobby and have more reliable damage dealing mechanism


Upcoming features

 Camera shake can be turned off
 Resolution, quality and other settings are to be implemented soonish
 The game start will have a grace period to avoid instant AI kills on players


Please give us feedback on the forums if the effects are a bit over the top or just fine

If you have any suggestions for features or you find bugs, contact us in Steam Community Hub or on our Discord server. Thanks for playing our game.
